4659-5224-6289-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1} due to Voyager Quickwelder, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

880-4862-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

339-677-3480-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1563-2457-7810-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4247-4535--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2366-4478-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4478-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-4766-7361.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more Spirits.
2921-4766-7361.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Kodama.
When Kodama dies, its soulshift ability and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Kodama from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

339-677-4460-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

628-2921-7213.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Encumbered Reejerey.
When Encumbered Reejerey dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

280-1479-7201.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-7201.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1283-2440-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's first ability by paying {3}, creating a 0/3 Wall creature token with defender.
When the Wall enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Wall you control.
Repeat.
1283-2440-7132.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use it to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

1510-2438-4574-5849.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

3532-4842-5060-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled by Cemetery Prowler.
3532-4842-5060-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4375-5361-6798.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-4316-4423-5034.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sol Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1350-4050-6741.manaNeeded: {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
1350-4050-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven multicolored permanents.
1350-4050-6741.description:
Cast Infinite Guideline Station either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eight times by sacrificing eight Robots, adding {2}{W}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Infinite Guideline Station from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Gogo.
Holding priority, activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the Aphetto Alchemist ability, targeting Gogo and Vhal.
Resolve both copies of the Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping Gogo and Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4659-5789-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4659-5789-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Lifecreed Duo indestructible.
3490-4659-5789-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

5226-5394-6291.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

2173-5220-6425.manaNeeded: {2}{W} in nonblue mana if Azorius Herald is in your hand
2173-5220-6425.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4 if Azorius Herald is on top of your library.
2173-5220-6425.description:
Cast Azorius Herald either from your hand by paying {2}{W} in nonblue mana, or from the top of your library by paying 3 life.
When Azorius Herald enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, causing you to gain 4 life and then sacrifice Azorius Herald.
When Azorius Herald dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Azorius Herald from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

413-3951-4452-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
413-3951-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

465-1849-3742-4251-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-1849-3742-4251-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

277-880-3703.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-3703.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

262-1064-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Born to Drive attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness, and has a power of one or greater.
262-1064-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Devoted Druid by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Devoted Druid has a power of two or greater, Devoted Druid becomes infinitely large, which allows you to use its mana ability instead to get infinite {G}.

1308-3389-4050-5043.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1183-1636-2584-4061.notablePrerequisites:
Dalakos does not have summoning sickness.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters.
1183-1636-2584-4061.description:
Activate Dalakos by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent on artifacts or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Creature tokens enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Pandemonium triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.

1188-1526-2232-2900.notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic Forest.
Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1188-1526-2232-2900.description:
Cast Quirion Ranger by paying {G}.
Quirion Ranger enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Elvish Pioneer from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Quirion Ranger by returning a basic Forest from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Cast Elvish Pioneer by paying {G}.
Elvish Pioneer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Elvish Pioneer trigger, putting a basic Forest from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Quirion Ranger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
